description: On the table in front are a bright green plate, a stack of red and blue plates behind it, several colorful plastic utensils to the left, and a yellow squeeze bottle to the right. The left hand holds the green plate steady while the right hand presses a blue scrub sponge onto the plate and wipes in short strokes across the surface, shifting slightly around the rim and toward the center as the plate is subtly rotated in the left hand; the green plate is a two-hand object and the sponge is a right-hand object.
